```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "scales")
missing <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Install required packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Discover one input per exposure. To restrict the report, set params$traits
# in the YAML header, e.g. ["sbp", "dbp"].
data_dir <- file.path("..", "data")
pattern <- "_pop_extract_common_snps_clumped_corrected\\.rds$"
all_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(all_files)) stop("No matching exposure RDS files found in ", data_dir)
trait_names <- sub(pattern, "", basename(all_files))
files <- stats::setNames(all_files, trait_names)
if (!is.null(params$traits)) {
  requested <- as.character(unlist(params$traits))
  unknown <- setdiff(requested, names(files))
  if (length(unknown)) stop("Unknown trait(s): ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
                            ". Available traits: ", paste(names(files), collapse = ", "))
  files <- files[requested]
}
populations <- c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "EUR", "SAS", "UGR")
alpha <- 0.05
# EUR is used as the discovery/reference population for replication analyses.
# The thresholds reproduce the original analyses: genome-wide significance for
# all SNPs, and nominal significance in the drug-target subset.
replication_discovery_p <- 5e-8
drug_replication_discovery_p <- 0.05

# Per-population heterogeneity contribution:
#   "loo" = leave-one-out standardised residual (recommended; ~N(0, 1) under
#           homogeneity for every population, including heavily weighted EUR)
#   "qj"  = original Q_j = w_j (beta_j - beta_IVW)^2 compared with chi-square(1)
#           (deflated for populations that dominate the IVW estimate)
contribution_method <- "loo"

# Cross-ancestry scatter figures (EUR vs each non-EUR population). Traits are
# grouped into one figure per group; traits absent from `files` are dropped.
figure_groups <- list(
  blood_pressure = c("sbp", "dbp", "pp"),
  lipids = c("ldlc", "hdl", "tg")
)
trait_labels <- c(sbp = "SBP", dbp = "DBP", pp = "PP",
                  ldlc = "LDL-C", hdl = "HDL-C", tg = "Triglycerides")
figure_dir <- file.path("..", "figures")
show_ci <- TRUE  # draw 95% CIs for the non-EUR estimates
```

# Analysis overview

The report analyses each matching exposure file in `../data/`. For every trait it includes the overall Cochran's Q heterogeneity test, per-population Q contributions, multiple-testing correction, and EUR-referenced expected-versus-observed replication analyses. Overall and drug-target heterogeneity tests use separate Bonferroni thresholds based on the number of testable SNPs, with FDR-adjusted p-values reported alongside.

```{r selected-inputs}
knitr::kable(data.frame(trait = names(files), input = basename(files)),
            caption = "Exposure datasets selected for analysis")
```

# Analysis functions

```{r functions}
fixed_effects_meta_analysis <- function(beta_vec, se_vec) {
  if (length(beta_vec) != length(se_vec)) stop("beta_vec and se_vec must have equal lengths")
  keep <- is.finite(beta_vec) & is.finite(se_vec) & se_vec > 0
  beta_vec <- beta_vec[keep]
  se_vec <- se_vec[keep]
  n <- length(beta_vec)
  if (!n) return(list(beta = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, Q = NA_real_, Qdf = 0L,
                      Qpval = NA_real_, Qj = numeric(), Qjpval = numeric()))
  w <- 1 / se_vec^2
  beta <- sum(beta_vec * w) / sum(w)
  se <- sqrt(1 / sum(w))
  Qj <- w * (beta - beta_vec)^2
  Q <- sum(Qj)
  Qdf <- n - 1L
  Qpval <- if (Qdf > 0L) pchisq(Q, df = Qdf, lower.tail = FALSE) else NA_real_
  # Leave-one-out standardised residual: compare each population with the IVW
  # estimate of all *other* populations. Unlike Q_j, this is ~N(0, 1) under
  # homogeneity whatever the population's weight.
  loo_z <- if (n >= 2L) {
    vapply(seq_len(n), function(j) {
      b_minus <- sum(beta_vec[-j] * w[-j]) / sum(w[-j])
      se_minus <- sqrt(1 / sum(w[-j]))
      (beta_vec[j] - b_minus) / sqrt(se_vec[j]^2 + se_minus^2)
    }, numeric(1))
  } else rep(NA_real_, n)
  list(beta = beta, se = se, Q = Q, Qdf = Qdf, Qpval = Qpval,
       Qj = Qj, Qjpval = pchisq(Qj, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE),
       loo_z = loo_z, loo_pval = 2 * pnorm(-abs(loo_z)))
}

combine_data <- function(sslist) {
  if (!length(sslist)) stop("sslist must not be empty")
  if (is.null(names(sslist)) || any(names(sslist) == "")) stop("sslist must be a named list")
  pieces <- lapply(seq_along(sslist), function(i) {
    pop <- names(sslist)[i]
    dat <- sslist[[i]]
    absent <- setdiff(c("snpid", "beta", "se"), names(dat))
    if (length(absent)) stop("Population ", pop, " is missing: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
    dat <- dat %>% select(snpid, beta, se) %>% filter(!is.na(snpid)) %>%
      distinct(snpid, .keep_all = TRUE)
    names(dat)[names(dat) == "beta"] <- paste0("beta_", pop)
    names(dat)[names(dat) == "se"] <- paste0("se_", pop)
    dat
  })
  Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "snpid"), pieces)
}

heterogeneity_test <- function(sslist, contribution = contribution_method) {
  contribution <- match.arg(contribution, c("loo", "qj"))
  contribution_field <- if (contribution == "loo") "loo_pval" else "Qjpval"
  if (length(sslist) < 2L) stop("At least two population datasets are required")
  if (is.null(names(sslist)) || any(names(sslist) == "")) stop("sslist must be a named list")
  joined <- combine_data(sslist)
  beta_cols <- paste0("beta_", names(sslist))
  se_cols <- paste0("se_", names(sslist))
  beta_mat <- as.matrix(joined[, beta_cols, drop = FALSE])
  se_mat <- as.matrix(joined[, se_cols, drop = FALSE])
  analyses <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(joined)), function(i) {
    fixed_effects_meta_analysis(as.numeric(beta_mat[i, ]), as.numeric(se_mat[i, ]))
  })
  q <- tibble::tibble(
    snpid = joined$snpid,
    beta_fixed = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "beta"),
    se_fixed = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "se"),
    Q = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "Q"),
    Qdf = vapply(analyses, `[[`, integer(1), "Qdf"),
    Qpval = vapply(analyses, `[[`, numeric(1), "Qpval"),
    n_pop = rowSums(is.finite(beta_mat) & is.finite(se_mat) & se_mat > 0)
  )
  qj_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(analyses), ncol = length(sslist),
                   dimnames = list(NULL, names(sslist)))
  for (i in seq_along(analyses)) {
    valid <- is.finite(beta_mat[i, ]) & is.finite(se_mat[i, ]) & se_mat[i, ] > 0
    if (any(valid)) qj_mat[i, valid] <- analyses[[i]][[contribution_field]]
  }
  qj <- as_tibble(qj_mat)
  qj$snpid <- joined$snpid
  list(Q = q, Qj = qj)
}

expected_vs_observed_replication <- function(b_disc, b_rep, se_disc, se_rep, alpha) {
  if (!(length(b_disc) == length(b_rep) && length(b_disc) == length(se_disc) &&
        length(b_disc) == length(se_rep))) stop("All vectors must have equal lengths")
  if (length(alpha) != 1L || !is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0 || alpha >= 1)
    stop("alpha must be between 0 and 1")
  keep <- is.finite(b_disc) & is.finite(b_rep) & is.finite(se_disc) &
    is.finite(se_rep) & se_disc > 0 & se_rep > 0
  b_disc <- b_disc[keep]; b_rep <- b_rep[keep]
  se_disc <- se_disc[keep]; se_rep <- se_rep[keep]
  p_sign <- pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_disc) * pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep) +
    (1 - pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_disc)) * (1 - pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep))
  # Expected power to reach two-sided significance in the replication sample if
  # the true effect equals the discovery estimate. (Previously the second term
  # used +abs(b_disc), so both terms were the lower tail and power was ~0.)
  p_sig <- pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep + qnorm(alpha / 2)) +
    (1 - pnorm(-abs(b_disc) / se_rep - qnorm(alpha / 2)))
  # Two-sided replication p-value, matching the two-sided expectation above.
  p_rep <- 2 * pnorm(abs(b_rep) / se_rep, lower.tail = FALSE)
  n <- length(b_disc)
  expected_sign <- sum(p_sign); observed_sign <- sum(sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep))
  expected_sig <- sum(p_sig); observed_sig <- sum(p_rep < alpha)
  binom_p <- function(observed, expected) {
    if (n == 0L || expected <= 0 || expected >= n) NA_real_
    else binom.test(observed, n, expected / n)$p.value
  }
  list(
    res = tibble::tibble(nsnp = rep(n, 4), metric = c("Sign", "Sign", "P-value", "P-value"),
      datum = c("Expected", "Observed", "Expected", "Observed"),
      value = c(expected_sign, observed_sign, expected_sig, observed_sig),
      pdiff = c(NA_real_, binom_p(observed_sign, expected_sign), NA_real_,
                binom_p(observed_sig, expected_sig))),
    variants = tibble::tibble(expected_power = p_sig, observed_sig = p_rep < alpha,
      replication_fail = p_sig > 0.95 & !(p_rep < alpha),
      expected_sign = p_sign, observed_sign = sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep),
      sign_fail = p_sign > 0.95 & !(sign(b_disc) == sign(b_rep)))
  )
}

forest_plot <- function(sslist, snp) {
  dat <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sslist), function(pop) {
    x <- sslist[[pop]]
    x <- x[x$snpid == snp, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
    tibble::tibble(beta = x$beta[1], se = x$se[1], label = pop)
  }))
  if (!nrow(dat)) stop("SNP not found: ", snp)
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = beta, y = label)) + geom_point() +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = beta - 1.96 * se, xmax = beta + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(x = "Effect estimate (95% CI)", y = "Population") + theme_bw()
}

plot_heterogeneous_snps <- function(dat, hits, plot_title) {
  if (!nrow(hits)) {
    cat("No SNPs pass the Bonferroni threshold for this analysis.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  plot_dat <- dat %>% semi_join(hits, by = "snpid") %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = populations))
  ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = beta, y = pop, colour = pop)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = beta - 1.96 * se, xmax = beta + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_point() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap(vars(snpid), scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Effect estimate (95% CI)", y = "Population") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
}

# Forest plot for drug-target Bonferroni hits. Everything is derived from the
# data: SNPs are ordered by heterogeneity p-value (strongest at the top), strip
# labels are "chr:pos_<target gene>", the combined row is the IVW fixed-effect
# estimate from heterogeneity_test(), and the population making the largest
# contribution to Q (smallest per-population Q p-value) is drawn as a square.
# Returns a list of plots, with at most snps_per_page SNPs per plot.
plot_drug_hits_forest <- function(dat, hits, qj, plot_title, snps_per_page = 3,
                                  gene_cols = c("Target gene", "target_gene", "gene", "Gene")) {
  if (!nrow(hits)) {
    cat("No SNPs pass the Bonferroni threshold for this analysis.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  hits <- hits %>% arrange(Qpval)
  snp_order <- hits$snpid

  # Strip labels: chromosome:position followed by the annotated target gene.
  gene_col <- intersect(gene_cols, names(dat))[1]
  label_dat <- dat %>% filter(snpid %in% snp_order) %>% distinct(snpid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  genes <- if (is.na(gene_col)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(label_dat)) else as.character(label_dat[[gene_col]])
  strip_labels <- ifelse(is.na(genes) | genes == "", label_dat$snpid,
                         paste0(sub("_.*$", "", label_dat$snpid), "_", genes))
  strip_labels <- stats::setNames(strip_labels, label_dat$snpid)

  # Population with the largest Q contribution for each SNP.
  lead_pop <- qj %>% filter(snpid %in% snp_order) %>%
    pivot_longer(-snpid, names_to = "pop", values_to = "p") %>%
    filter(is.finite(p)) %>% group_by(snpid) %>% filter(p == min(p)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% transmute(snpid, pop, lead = TRUE)

  point_levels <- c("Population estimate", "Largest Q contribution", "Combined (IVW fixed effect)")
  plot_dat <- bind_rows(
    dat %>% filter(snpid %in% snp_order) %>% select(snpid, pop, beta, se) %>%
      mutate(pop = as.character(pop)),
    hits %>% transmute(snpid, pop = "Combined", beta = beta_fixed, se = se_fixed)
  ) %>%
    left_join(lead_pop, by = c("snpid", "pop")) %>%
    mutate(
      point_type = factor(case_when(pop == "Combined" ~ point_levels[3],
                                    !is.na(lead) ~ point_levels[2],
                                    TRUE ~ point_levels[1]), levels = point_levels),
      # Reverse so populations read top-down with Combined at the bottom.
      pop = factor(pop, levels = rev(c(populations, "Combined"))),
      snpid = factor(snpid, levels = snp_order)
    )

  # Split many hits across several figures so each panel stays legible.
  pages <- split(snp_order, ceiling(seq_along(snp_order) / snps_per_page))
  lapply(seq_along(pages), function(i) {
    page_title <- if (length(pages) > 1L)
      sprintf("%s (%d of %d)", plot_title, i, length(pages)) else plot_title
    page_dat <- plot_dat %>% filter(snpid %in% pages[[i]]) %>%
      mutate(snpid = factor(as.character(snpid), levels = pages[[i]]))
    forest_page(page_dat, strip_labels, point_levels, page_title)
  })
}

forest_page <- function(plot_dat, strip_labels, point_levels, plot_title) {
  ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = beta, y = pop, shape = point_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = beta - 1.96 * se, xmax = beta + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_grid(snpid ~ ., switch = "y", scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
               labeller = labeller(snpid = as_labeller(strip_labels))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = stats::setNames(c(19, 15, 17), point_levels), drop = FALSE,
                       name = NULL) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Beta (95% CI)") +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

plot_qj <- function(qj, plot_title) {
  long <- qj %>% pivot_longer(-snpid, names_to = "population", values_to = "p") %>%
    filter(is.finite(p), p > 0, p <= 1)
  if (!nrow(long)) {
    cat("No per-population Q contribution p-values are available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  ggplot(long, aes(x = snpid, y = -log10(p), colour = population)) +
    geom_point() + scale_colour_brewer(type = "qual") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "SNP", y = "-log10 per-population contribution p-value", colour = "Population") +
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                       axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
}

make_qq_plot <- function(qj, plot_title) {
  qqdat <- qj %>% pivot_longer(-snpid, names_to = "Population", values_to = "p") %>%
    filter(is.finite(p), p > 0, p <= 1) %>%
    group_by(Population) %>% arrange(p, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(observed = -log10(p), expected = -log10(ppoints(n()))) %>% ungroup()
  if (!nrow(qqdat)) {
    cat("No per-population Q contribution p-values are available for a QQ plot.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  lambda_gc <- function(p) {
    chisq <- qchisq(1 - pmax(pmin(p, 1 - .Machine$double.eps), .Machine$double.xmin), df = 1)
    median(chisq, na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, df = 1)
  }
  lambda_df <- qqdat %>% group_by(Population) %>%
    summarise(lambda = lambda_gc(p), .groups = "drop")
  qqdat <- qqdat %>% left_join(lambda_df, by = "Population") %>%
    mutate(Population = factor(Population, levels = lambda_df$Population,
      labels = sprintf("%s (lambda = %.3f)", lambda_df$Population, lambda_df$lambda)))
  p <- ggplot(qqdat, aes(expected, observed, colour = Population)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Population") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Expected -log10(P)", y = "Observed -log10(P)") +
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")
  print(p)
  print(lambda_df)
  invisible(p)
}

replication_by_population <- function(reference, target, selection_p, alpha) {
  if (!"pval" %in% names(reference)) return(NULL)
  disc <- reference %>% filter(is.finite(pval), pval < selection_p) %>%
    select(snpid, beta, se)
  paired <- disc %>% inner_join(target %>% select(snpid, beta, se), by = "snpid",
                                suffix = c("_disc", "_rep"))
  result <- expected_vs_observed_replication(
    paired$beta_disc, paired$beta_rep, paired$se_disc, paired$se_rep, alpha)
  list(res = result$res, variants = bind_cols(tibble::tibble(snpid = paired$snpid), result$variants),
       n_discovery = nrow(disc), n_paired = nrow(paired))
}

# Pair each non-EUR population with EUR and orient every SNP to the
# EUR effect-increasing allele (both betas flipped when the EUR beta is
# negative). Assumes alleles are already harmonised to EUR upstream.
eur_oriented_pairs <- function(dat, pops) {
  eur <- dat %>% filter(pop == "EUR") %>% select(snpid, beta_EUR = beta, se_EUR = se)
  dat %>% filter(pop %in% setdiff(pops, "EUR")) %>%
    select(snpid, pop, beta, se) %>%
    inner_join(eur, by = "snpid") %>%
    mutate(flip = ifelse(beta_EUR < 0, -1, 1),
           x = beta_EUR * flip, y = beta * flip,
           x_se = se_EUR, y_se = se)
}

# Per-population transferability summary against EUR:
#   IVW slope through the origin of non-EUR on EUR betas (weights 1/se_pop^2),
#   proportion of SNPs with the same sign, and the Pearson correlation.
transferability_summary <- function(pairs) {
  pairs %>% group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      n_snps = n(),
      ivw_slope = sum(x * y / y_se^2) / sum(x^2 / y_se^2),
      ivw_slope_se = sqrt(1 / sum(x^2 / y_se^2)),
      sign_concordance = mean(y > 0),
      pearson_r = cor(x, y),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(ivw_slope_lci = ivw_slope - 1.96 * ivw_slope_se,
           ivw_slope_uci = ivw_slope + 1.96 * ivw_slope_se,
           .after = ivw_slope_se)
}

# Grid of EUR vs non-EUR scatter plots: rows = traits, columns = populations.
# Every row shares its axis limits, so panels within a trait are comparable.
plot_cross_ancestry <- function(pairs_by_trait, plot_title = NULL, show_ci = TRUE) {
  label_of <- function(tr) dplyr::coalesce(unname(trait_labels[tr]), toupper(tr))
  pairs <- bind_rows(pairs_by_trait, .id = "trait") %>%
    mutate(trait_label = factor(label_of(trait), levels = label_of(names(pairs_by_trait))),
           pop = factor(pop, levels = intersect(setdiff(populations, "EUR"), unique(pop))))
  stats <- pairs %>% group_by(trait, trait_label) %>%
    group_modify(~ transferability_summary(.x)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = levels(pairs$pop))) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("slope %.2f (%.2f, %.2f)\nsign %.0f%%, n = %d",
                           ivw_slope, ivw_slope_lci, ivw_slope_uci,
                           100 * sign_concordance, n_snps))
  # Per-trait limits, shared across populations; include 0 and the x range
  # so the y = x line is always visible.
  lims <- pairs %>% group_by(trait_label) %>%
    summarise(xmax = max(x) * 1.05,
              ymin = min(c(y, 0)), ymax = max(c(y, x)), .groups = "drop")
  blank <- bind_rows(
    lims %>% transmute(trait_label, x = 0, y = ymin),
    lims %>% transmute(trait_label, x = xmax, y = ymax)
  ) %>% tidyr::crossing(pop = factor(levels(pairs$pop), levels = levels(pairs$pop)))
  ci <- pairs %>% left_join(lims, by = "trait_label") %>%
    mutate(lo = pmax(y - 1.96 * y_se, ymin), hi = pmin(y + 1.96 * y_se, ymax))

  p <- ggplot(pairs, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_blank(data = blank) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40")
  if (show_ci) {
    p <- p + geom_linerange(data = ci, aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                            colour = "grey70", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  p + geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(data = stats, aes(intercept = 0, slope = ivw_slope),
                colour = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(vars(trait_label, pop), ncol = nlevels(pairs$pop), scales = "free") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)) +
    labs(title = plot_title,
         x = "European beta (oriented to EUR effect-increasing allele)",
         y = "Non-European beta (same allele)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

# Results by exposure

```{r analyse-traits, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
all_pairs <- list()
all_transferability <- list()
for (trait in names(files)) {
  cat("\n## ", toupper(trait), "\n\n", sep = "")
  dat <- readRDS(files[[trait]])
  required <- c("snpid", "pop", "beta", "se")
  absent <- setdiff(required, names(dat))
  if (length(absent)) {
    cat("Skipped: required columns missing: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    next
  }
  dat <- dat %>% filter(pop %in% populations, !is.na(snpid), is.finite(beta),
                        is.finite(se), se > 0) %>% arrange(pop, snpid) %>%
    distinct(pop, snpid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  pops <- populations[populations %in% unique(dat$pop)]
  if (length(pops) < 2L) {
    cat("Skipped: fewer than two configured populations have valid data.\n\n")
    next
  }
  sslist <- stats::setNames(lapply(pops, function(p) filter(dat, pop == p)), pops)
  result <- heterogeneity_test(sslist)

  # EUR-referenced transferability: IVW slope, sign concordance, correlation.
  if ("EUR" %in% pops) {
    all_pairs[[trait]] <- eur_oriented_pairs(dat, pops)
    all_transferability[[trait]] <- transferability_summary(all_pairs[[trait]]) %>%
      mutate(trait = trait, .before = 1)
  }
  n_tests <- sum(!is.na(result$Q$Qpval))
  mt_thres <- if (n_tests > 0L) alpha / n_tests else NA_real_
  result$Q <- result$Q %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(Qpval, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(Qpval)
  hits <- result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval <= mt_thres)
  nominal_hits <- result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval < alpha)

  counts <- tibble::tibble(population = pops,
    variants = vapply(pops, function(p) sum(dat$pop == p), integer(1)))
  summary <- tibble::tibble(
    variants_tested = n_tests,
    bonferroni_threshold = mt_thres,
    nominal_Q_p_lt_0_05 = nrow(nominal_hits),
    bonferroni_significant = nrow(hits),
    FDR_lt_0_05 = sum(result$Q$fdr < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    smallest_Q_p = if (!n_tests) NA_real_ else min(result$Q$Qpval, na.rm = TRUE),
    smallest_FDR = if (all(is.na(result$Q$fdr))) NA_real_ else min(result$Q$fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  cat("**Variant counts by population**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(counts))
  cat("\n\n**Overall heterogeneity summary**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(summary, digits = 5))
  if (!is.null(all_transferability[[trait]])) {
    cat("\n\n**Transferability versus EUR (SNPs oriented to the EUR effect-increasing allele)**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(all_transferability[[trait]] %>% select(-trait), digits = 3))
  }
  cat("\n\n**SNPs passing this trait's Bonferroni threshold**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(hits %>% select(snpid, n_pop, beta_fixed, se_fixed, Q, Qdf, Qpval, fdr), digits = 5))
  cat("\n\n**Nominally heterogeneous SNPs (Q p < 0.05): per-population Q contributions**\n\n")
  if (nrow(nominal_hits)) {
    nominal_qj <- result$Qj %>% semi_join(nominal_hits, by = "snpid")
    print(knitr::kable(nominal_qj, digits = 5))
  } else {
    cat("No SNPs have nominal Q p < 0.05.\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n**Per-population Q contribution plot** (method: ", contribution_method, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  print(plot_qj(result$Qj, paste0(toupper(trait), ": per-population Q contributions")))
  cat("\n\n**QQ plot and genomic inflation estimates for per-population Q contributions**\n\n")
  make_qq_plot(result$Qj, paste0(toupper(trait), ": per-population Q contribution QQ plot"))
  cat("\n\n**Population-specific estimates for Bonferroni-significant SNPs**\n\n")
  print(plot_heterogeneous_snps(dat, hits, paste0(toupper(trait), ": Bonferroni-significant heterogeneity SNPs")))

  qj_long <- result$Qj %>% pivot_longer(-snpid, names_to = "population", values_to = "p") %>%
    filter(!is.na(p))
  qj_summary <- qj_long %>% group_by(population) %>%
    summarise(variants_with_estimate = n(),
      fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05 = mean(p < alpha), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05))
  cat("\n\n**Population-level Q contribution summary**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(qj_summary, digits = 3))

  # EUR-referenced expected-versus-observed replication for the full exposure.
  if ("EUR" %in% pops && "pval" %in% names(dat)) {
    cat("\n\n### Expected versus observed replication: all exposure SNPs\n\n")
    reference <- filter(dat, pop == "EUR")
    replication_rows <- list()
    replication_failures <- list()
    for (target_pop in setdiff(pops, "EUR")) {
      comparison <- replication_by_population(reference, filter(dat, pop == target_pop),
                                               replication_discovery_p, alpha)
      if (is.null(comparison)) next
      # Save the list values before mutate creates a column with the same name.
      n_discovery <- comparison$n_discovery
      n_paired <- comparison$n_paired
      replication_rows[[target_pop]] <- comparison$res %>%
        mutate(comparison = paste("EUR vs", target_pop),
               n_discovery = n_discovery, n_paired = n_paired, .before = 1)
      if (nrow(comparison$variants)) {
        replication_failures[[target_pop]] <- comparison$variants %>%
          mutate(comparison = paste("EUR vs", target_pop), .before = 1)
      }
    }
    if (length(replication_rows)) {
      replication_table <- bind_rows(replication_rows)
      print(knitr::kable(replication_table, digits = 5,
        caption = paste0("EUR discovery SNPs with p < ", format(replication_discovery_p, scientific = TRUE),
                         "; replication significance alpha = 0.05")))
      failure_table <- bind_rows(replication_failures)
      if (nrow(failure_table)) {
        failures <- failure_table %>% filter(replication_fail | sign_fail) %>%
          select(comparison, snpid, expected_power, observed_sig, replication_fail,
                 expected_sign, observed_sign, sign_fail)
        cat("\n\n**Variants with expected-but-not-observed replication**\n\n")
        if (nrow(failures)) print(knitr::kable(failures, digits = 5)) else cat("No variants meet the expected replication failure criteria.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("Replication analysis skipped: EUR estimates or p-values are unavailable.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n\nReplication analysis skipped: EUR data or p-values are unavailable.\n")
  }

  if ("Drug" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat_drug <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(Drug), as.character(Drug) != "")
    drug_pops <- pops[vapply(pops, function(p) any(dat_drug$pop == p), logical(1))]
    if (nrow(dat_drug) && length(drug_pops) >= 2L) {
      drug_sslist <- stats::setNames(lapply(drug_pops, function(p) filter(dat_drug, pop == p)), drug_pops)
      drug_result <- heterogeneity_test(drug_sslist)
      n_drug_tests <- sum(!is.na(drug_result$Q$Qpval))
      drug_mt_thres <- if (n_drug_tests > 0L) alpha / n_drug_tests else NA_real_
      drug_result$Q <- drug_result$Q %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(Qpval, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(Qpval)
      drug_hits <- drug_result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval <= drug_mt_thres)
      drug_nominal_hits <- drug_result$Q %>% filter(!is.na(Qpval), Qpval < alpha)
      drug_map <- dat_drug %>% distinct(snpid, Drug)
      drug_summary <- drug_result$Q %>% left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid") %>%
        group_by(Drug) %>% summarise(n_snps = n_distinct(snpid),
          n_nominal_Q_p_lt_0_05 = n_distinct(snpid[snpid %in% drug_nominal_hits$snpid]),
          n_bonferroni_significant = n_distinct(snpid[snpid %in% drug_hits$snpid]),
          proportion_FDR_lt_0_05 = mean(fdr < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_Q_p = median(Qpval, na.rm = TRUE), median_FDR = median(fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
          min_FDR = min(fdr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(desc(n_bonferroni_significant), median_Q_p)
      cat("\n\n### Drug-target subset heterogeneity\n\n")
      cat("Tests: ", n_drug_tests, "; Bonferroni threshold: ", signif(drug_mt_thres, 5),
          "; significant SNPs: ", nrow(drug_hits), "\n\n", sep = "")
      cat("**Summary by drug class**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(drug_summary, digits = 4))
      cat("\n\n**Drug-target SNPs passing this subset's Bonferroni threshold**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(drug_hits %>% left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid") %>%
        select(snpid, Drug, n_pop, beta_fixed, se_fixed, Q, Qdf, Qpval, fdr), digits = 5))
      cat("\n\n**Nominal drug-target heterogeneity: per-population Q contributions**\n\n")
      if (nrow(drug_nominal_hits)) {
        drug_nominal_qj <- drug_result$Qj %>% semi_join(drug_nominal_hits, by = "snpid") %>%
          left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid")
        print(knitr::kable(drug_nominal_qj, digits = 5))
      } else {
        cat("No drug-target SNPs have nominal Q p < 0.05.\n")
      }
      cat("\n\n**Drug-target per-population Q contribution plot**\n\n")
      print(plot_qj(drug_result$Qj, paste0(toupper(trait), ": drug-target per-population Q contributions")))
      cat("\n\n**Drug-target QQ plot and genomic inflation estimates**\n\n")
      make_qq_plot(drug_result$Qj, paste0(toupper(trait), ": drug-target Q contribution QQ plot"))
      cat("\n\n**Population-specific estimates for drug-target Bonferroni hits**\n\n")
      drug_forest_plots <- plot_drug_hits_forest(dat_drug, drug_hits, drug_result$Qj,
        paste0(toupper(trait), ": drug-target Bonferroni-significant SNPs"))
      for (p in drug_forest_plots) print(p)

      drug_qj_summary <- drug_result$Qj %>% left_join(drug_map, by = "snpid") %>%
        pivot_longer(all_of(drug_pops), names_to = "population", values_to = "p") %>%
        group_by(Drug, population) %>%
        summarise(variants_with_estimate = sum(!is.na(p)),
          fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05 = if (all(is.na(p))) NA_real_ else mean(p < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(Drug, desc(fraction_contribution_p_lt_0_05))
      cat("\n\n**Per-population Q contribution fractions by drug class**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(drug_qj_summary, digits = 3))

      # Drug-target EUR replication, using nominal EUR discovery p < 0.05 as in
      # the original target-stratified analysis. Pair variants by identifier.
      if ("EUR" %in% drug_pops && "pval" %in% names(dat_drug)) {
        cat("\n\n### Expected versus observed replication: drug-target SNPs\n\n")
        drug_reference <- filter(dat_drug, pop == "EUR")
        drug_replication_rows <- list()
        for (target_pop in setdiff(drug_pops, "EUR")) {
          comparison <- replication_by_population(drug_reference, filter(dat_drug, pop == target_pop),
                                                   drug_replication_discovery_p, alpha)
          if (is.null(comparison)) next
          # Save the list values before mutate creates a column with the same name.
          n_discovery <- comparison$n_discovery
          n_paired <- comparison$n_paired
          drug_replication_rows[[target_pop]] <- comparison$res %>%
            mutate(comparison = paste("EUR vs", target_pop),
                   n_discovery = n_discovery, n_paired = n_paired, .before = 1)
        }
        if (length(drug_replication_rows)) {
          print(knitr::kable(bind_rows(drug_replication_rows), digits = 5,
            caption = paste0("Drug-target EUR discovery SNPs with p < ", drug_replication_discovery_p,
                             "; replication significance alpha = 0.05")))
        } else {
          cat("No drug-target replication comparisons are available.\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("\n\nDrug-target replication skipped: EUR data or p-values are unavailable.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("\n\nDrug-target analysis skipped: fewer than two populations have annotated variants.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n\nNo `Drug` annotation column; drug-target analysis not applicable.\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
}
```

# Cross-ancestry effect comparison figures

Each panel plots non-European against European effect estimates for the LD-clumped instruments, with every SNP oriented to the European effect-increasing allele, so concordant SNPs lie above zero. The dashed line is y = x and the blue line is the IVW slope through the origin. Grey bars are 95% CIs for the non-European estimates, truncated at the panel limits. Panels in the same row share axis limits. Figures are also saved to `figure_dir` as PDF and PNG.

```{r cross-ancestry-figures, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
for (group in names(figure_groups)) {
  group_traits <- intersect(figure_groups[[group]], names(all_pairs))
  if (!length(group_traits)) next
  p <- plot_cross_ancestry(all_pairs[group_traits], show_ci = show_ci)
  print(p)
  for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) {
    ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0("cross_ancestry_", group, ".", ext)), p,
           width = 12, height = 2.8 * length(group_traits) + 0.6, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r transferability-table}
if (length(all_transferability)) {
  knitr::kable(bind_rows(all_transferability), digits = 3,
               caption = "IVW slope of non-EUR on EUR betas, sign concordance and correlation, by trait and population")
}
```

# Interpretation and reproducibility

For each exposure, Cochran's Q is calculated from the population-specific estimates using inverse-variance fixed-effect weights. Per-population contribution p-values describe how far each population departs from the others. With `contribution_method = "loo"` (default), each population's estimate is compared with the IVW estimate of the remaining populations, (beta_j - beta_-j) / sqrt(se_j^2 + se_-j^2), which is ~N(0, 1) under homogeneity for every population. The original Q_j = w_j (beta_j - beta_IVW)^2 statistic (`"qj"`) is deflated for populations that dominate the IVW estimate, such as EUR. Replication uses EUR as the discovery/reference population and compares observed replication with expected rates under the discovery effects and replication sampling variation. Expected significance is the two-sided power at alpha given the discovery effect and the replication SE, and observed significance uses a two-sided replication p-value. Because EUR discovery effects are selected on significance, they may be inflated by winner's curse, so expected counts are likely upper bounds. Non-EUR estimates in the input files have been rescaled by their slope against EUR (beta / slope, se / slope); this preserves each SNP's z-statistic, sign and significance, but it means the scatter-plot slopes are close to 1 partly by construction.

```{r session-info}
cat("Selected traits:", paste(names(files), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Population labels configured:", paste(populations, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Overall replication discovery p threshold:", replication_discovery_p, "\n")
cat("Drug-target replication discovery p threshold:", drug_replication_discovery_p, "\n")
cat("Per-population contribution method:", contribution_method, "\n\n")
print(sessionInfo())
```
